attempts.summary: Created a local CA "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (Ubuntu 16.04) and installed it as a trusted system CA. Key generated with openssl genrsa 4096, self-signed x509 cert built with a compatible config file (openssl 1.0.2 lacks -addext), copied to /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ and activated via update-ca-certificates, which produced the PEM plus subject-hash symlinks in /etc/ssl/certs. Verified openssl trusts it by default (no -CAfile override needed). Completed mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline and CA health, rebooted node1 via `shutdown -r now`, confirmed connection refused during the outage window, polled until SSH returned, verified boot_id changed, and re-verified CA trust (checksum, symlink, openssl verify, subject/dates) all matched post-restart.
